verdict.rationale: The roadmap documents a first-party Rust API client beta release, which shows turbopuffer ships official SDKs. But the only one evidenced is a single beta-stage client, and the pack names no other language SDKs, install or usage docs, or hands-on reports. Missing for 10: documented stable SDKs across major languages (e.g., Python/TypeScript/Go), SDK reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), independent corroboration of SDK quality.
